transport_intermediary_service.label: Transport-intermediary service
transport_intermediary_service.value: Global logistics services: air and ocean freight forwarding, customs brokerage, warehousing and distribution, and supply chain management

transport_booking_specialization.label: Transport / booking specialization
transport_booking_specialization.value: Multimodal global logistics, including air freight (e.g. finished vehicles by air, AOG aviation solutions) and technology-enabled shipment booking and visibility

asset_ownership_control.label: Asset ownership / control
asset_ownership_control.value: Asset-light, service-based network; does not own the aircraft, ships or trucks it uses; operates warehousing and distribution services

customs_border_responsibilities.label: Customs / border responsibilities
customs_border_responsibilities.value: Customs compliance and trade documentation automation; guides clients through U.S. Customs and Border Protection system changes; cross-border operations

gross_net_revenue_presentation.label: Gross / net revenue presentation
gross_net_revenue_presentation.value: Freight purchased from carriers and resold, with revenue presented gross for freight services and net for customs brokerage and related fees

notes: Gross/net revenue presentation and activity volume are not on the website; the revenue presentation comes from general knowledge.
